headline: Accepted resignation of Joseph Corso and retirement of Stacia Doyle; took no action on appointing a Business Manager.
summary: The board met in executive session to interview candidates for Business Manager. After reconvening, the board accepted the resignation of Joseph Corso and the retirement of Stacia Doyle. The board discussed appointing a Business Manager but took no action.
decisions: Unanimous approval to go into Executive Session under Connecticut General Statutes Section 1-200(6)(a) to interview and discuss candidates for Business Manager.
Unanimous approval to come out of Executive Session at 8:40 p.m.
Unanimous approval to accept the resignation of Joseph Corso effective September 26, 2026.
Unanimous approval to accept the retirement of Stacia Doyle effective September 5, 2026.
No action taken on the appointment of a candidate for Business Manager.
